title: Tinted-panel phone close-ups, icon then wordmark
summary: A light phone leaned back in perspective, five shallow-focus close-ups, each screen on its own slanted pastel panel and drifting slowly. Hard cuts between screens, then a quiet close: icon alone, then wordmark alone, on white.
use_when: A mobile app with four or five distinct screens and a calm, clean brand
Silent autoplay feeds where each screen must read on its own for about 3.5 s
Showing breadth of an app (account, onboarding, support, main screen) without a narrative
A pastel per-screen colour code is wanted to separate features

look.type_style: headline: rounded geometric sans, medium weight, sentence case, 2 lines, about 5 % of frame height, trailing words fade to light grey; wordmark: bold grotesk, about 3 % of frame height, centred

sfx.event: hard cut to the next phone screen (rows 2-5)
icon swaps to the wordmark in place (row 8)

structure.shot: phone leaned back, top third in frame, on a slanted lilac panel; 2-line headline above it (claim, 3 words + 7 words)
structure.camera: dolly: content moves left about 84 px/s at 1920 wide (2.8 px/fr) plus push-in about 1.00 -> 1.07 across the row (motion.json 1.0-2.0 %/s)
structure.motion: fade up from white, 6 fr, easings.outQuint (30 fps strip at t = 0); then only the camera move, no element animation; tilt-plane with a focus band through the phone top, upper text and right side soft

structure.shot: macro on the account screen: blue header, avatar with a membership badge, email line, status card below; light-green panel at the left edge
structure.camera: push-in decelerating, about 3.9 %/s then 1.6 then 0.8 %/s (motion.json); content rises about 25-35 px/s; slight roll (motion.json estimate, not checked)
structure.motion: no element animation visible at 4 fps; shallow focus on the badge and email line, bottom card blurred

structure.shot: guest screen: grey gradient screen with a pale avatar, short status line and sign-in button; slanted light-green panel left
structure.camera: dolly left about 45 px/s at 1920 wide (1.5 px/fr), scale constant (motion.json zoom -0.4..0.5 %/s)
structure.motion: none besides the camera; left half of the frame is soft white blur

structure.shot: support screen: title line, blue band with a chat pill and a sender row; slanted tan panel behind with a cropped 2-line claim at the top edge
structure.camera: dolly up-right about 30 px/s plus push-in 0.9 -> 3.3 %/s, accelerating into the cut (motion.json)
structure.motion: none besides the camera; focus on the title, the band fades out of focus to the bottom

structure.shot: main screen: header with the mark and name, upload and download speed readouts, concentric rings at the bottom; slanted aqua panel left
structure.camera: near hold: pull about 0.5 %/s (1.00 -> 0.98), position steady within 2 px per cell (sheets 04-05)
structure.motion: no element animation visible at 4 fps (readouts do not count)

structure.shot: extreme close-up of the phone's left edge: a corner of the speed readout and rings, the frame mostly aqua glow on white
structure.camera: drift right about 55 px/s at 1920 wide, measured from cell positions (motion.json reads hold: textureless frame)
structure.motion: picture changes abruptly at 18.90 (near miss 4.39 in cuts.json, below the cut threshold); then only the drift

structure.shot: app icon alone, a small blue rounded square (about 7 % of width) centred on white
structure.motion: appears at full size in one frame (30 fps strip at t = 23.0, near miss 4.31 in cuts.json); holds 75 fr

structure.shot: wordmark alone, black, small (about 16 % of width), centred on white
structure.motion: replaces the icon in one frame (30 fps strip at t = 25.4), no animation; holds 89 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json: accent for the UI, bg white, display font for the headline, wordmark and mark
params.content.headline: 2-line claim over the first shot, short first line of 2-3 words
params.content.screens: 5 phone screens (UI rebuilt), each with a pastel panel colour
params.content.panelColors: one pastel tint per screen, e.g. lilac, green, green, tan, aqua
params.timing.shot: frames per screen at 30 fps (reference 98-127, about 3.5 s)
params.timing.iconHold: frames the icon holds before the wordmark (reference 75)
params.timing.wordmarkHold: frames the wordmark holds to the end (reference 89)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets, 30 fps strips at t = 0, 18.5, 23.0, 25.4, and motion.json (block matching; rotation values not checked). Only 4 hard cuts are in cuts.json; the picture changes at 18.90 and 23.03 are near misses there, so they are written as continuous and called out in shot/motion. No element animation is visible at 4 fps: every shot lives on the camera move and the focus band. Speeds per shot in px/s are normalized to 1920 wide. Sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). The slanted per-screen pastel panel has no studio component (see recipe.md Missing components).
